title: CAUSE ME TO COME TO THY RIVER

lines.text: Cause me to come to Thy river O Lord.
Cause me to drink at Thy river O Lord.
Cause me to live in Thy river O Lord.
Cause me to come, cause me to drink,

[D]Cause me to [G]drink at Thy [D]river O [A]Lord.
[D]Cause me to [G]live in Thy [D]river O [A]Lord.
[G]Cause me to [D]come, [G]cause me to [D]drink,

lyrics:
[Verse]
Cause me to come to Thy river O Lord.
Cause me to drink at Thy river O Lord.
Cause me to live in Thy river O Lord.
Cause me to come, cause me to drink,
Cause me to live.
